_receta: +1 por paso (+1 Speed Keyboard Escape, Monkey Escape): el personaje corriendo en diagonal, muchos '+1' saltando y el número de velocidad. Movimiento y conteo.
_valores: Boceto: avatar = personaje corriendo. Texto: speed = 1,000,000 SPEED (o el número que corresponda). IA (en inglés): world_desc.

ia.prompt: {{AVATAR}} sprints diagonally toward the camera at super speed, leaning forward with a determined grin, speed lines and a wind trail behind, glowing sneakers. Setting: {{world_desc}}, a long colorful track stretching into the distance. Leave empty space around the avatar for big '+1' numbers that are added later (do not draw them). The avatar fills the middle ~50% of the frame.
